notes: Runner: Claude Code remote with both repos attached. Identity verified via the GitHub MCP as masenf. api.github.com is unreachable from the sandbox, so the listing and merge boxes came from the GitHub MCP (list_pull_requests, search for author_association, pull_request_read get/get_reviews/get_review_comments/get_check_runs/get_comments, get_job_logs), and head SHAs from anonymous git ls-remote.

Listing: 92 rows at 18:39Z vs a search counter of 91; #7001 merged at 18:40:32Z mid-scrape and was dropped. 91 open, 27 drafts, 64 non-draft measured against main 2fc45ed5 (fetched after the #7001 merge).

Merge boxes gathered by 11 subagents in batches of 4-6 PRs; four of them hit a spend-limit 429 mid-batch, but every file was on disk and validated (number, head SHA vs listing). Failing job logs were read for every red check; logs older than ~90 days (runs from May/June) return 410 Gone and are marked as such.

The MCP get does not expose the mergeable boolean; mergeable is derived from mergeable_state (dirty = CONFLICTING, otherwise MERGEABLE; 'unknown' re-fetched once). Six files where the agent wrote UNKNOWN with mergeable_state=blocked were normalised to MERGEABLE with a note.

Scoring per references/scoring.md. Stacked children carry a -1.5 penalty because they cannot merge before their parent. Ties at 5.5 (#7015, #7019, #6925, #6181, #6770 vs #6968) broken in favour of the PR that unblocks another; the rest are listed in one-fix-away or structural.
